A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same GravMAD work and contain the complete main text and Appendices A–E. Text extraction and rendered-page inspection support reliable comparison of the equations, algorithms, tables, and figures.

before.justification: V4 reports original RLBench experiments, ablations, and additional analyses, plus success rates on ten real-robot tasks in Table 11.

after.justification: V7 retains these original simulation and real-robot results, including the comparative experiments and analyses in Appendix D.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Appendix A retain the same Sub-goal Keypose Discovery, GravMap construction, foundation-model inference pipeline, diffusion architecture, and losses. The new reinforcement-learning suggestion is future work, not an implemented component.

E1.justification: Both evaluate the same 12 RLBench base tasks, eight principal novel tasks, three additional novel tasks in Appendix D.4, and ten real-world tasks in Appendix D.6. Their task requirements and represented scenarios are unchanged.

E2.justification: The main comparisons retain VoxPoser, Act3D, and 3D Diffuser Actor. Both versions also retain VoxPoser (Manual) and Chained Diffuser (Oracle) in Table 7, and Chained Diffuser (Oracle) in Table 8.

E3.justification: The reported protocols retain 20 demonstrations per base task, 600k training iterations, 25-episode simulation evaluations, success-rate/rank metrics, and Manual/VLM settings. Appendix scaling protocols and ten-episode real-world evaluations are also unchanged.

E4.justification: Figures 4 and 16 retain the same component ablations, including the additional cost-map analysis. Failure cases, sub-goal illustrations, data/viewpoint scaling, and challenging-task analyses in Appendices B–D are unchanged.

E5.justification: Both report the same three-seed evaluations and uncertainty presentation in Tables 1–2. No repeated-run information, uncertainty-reporting practice, or statistical testing procedure is added or revised.

E6.justification: Matched results are unchanged: Table 1 retains 62.92% for GravMAD (VLM) and 34.29% for VoxPoser; Table 2 retains 69.17% for GravMAD (Manual) and 56.72% for GravMAD (VLM). Appendix Tables 6–11 and the plotted numerical and qualitative findings are also unchanged.

T1.justification: The problem formulation, sub-goal definitions, equations (1)–(6), and mathematical construction of GravMaps remain identical. No assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims about combining imitation learning with foundation-model guidance. The headline claims of 28.63% novel-task and 13.36% base-task improvements are unchanged.

C2.justification: Appendix E adds exploration-based learning combined with reinforcement learning as a possible response to the existing generalization limitation, citing Hao et al. (2024). This modestly extends the proposed remedies without changing the documented failure conditions or result interpretations.

D1.justification: Algorithms 1–5, hyperparameter Table 3, task modifications, hardware and camera details, and real-robot implementation information are retained. The prompt and video access disclosures are also unchanged.

R1.justification: V7 adds references to TILD, dual cognition-action imitation, and reinforcement-learning exploration. In Section 2, the two new Chen references locally replace citations to Brohan et al. (2023a) and Goyal et al. (2023), which remain cited elsewhere. The overall research positioning is unchanged.

P1.justification: V7 corrects citation syntax, updates bibliography formatting and year suffixes, and consolidates duplicate RLBench references. Apart from the short Appendix E addition and limited paragraph adjustments, the prose and section organization remain the same.

P2.justification: All figures and table structures are retained. Changes are limited to local text spacing and page reflow, bibliography layout, and the corrected RLBench citation in Table 4's caption.

improvement.justification: V7 provides small bibliographic corrections and a brief additional future-work suggestion in Appendix E. The methods, empirical support, reproducibility information, and substantive applicability limits remain unchanged. These editorial and contextual adjustments do not materially alter the paper's overall quality.
